name: how-to-guide
title: How-to guide
description: A step-by-step guide: time and difficulty up front, a tick-off checklist of what you need, numbered steps with pictures and tips, and a closing summary.
docs: Each step is an anchor (#step-4) a reader can link to. Use tip for a hint and warning for a step that can go wrong. Pass plain strings in requirements for one list, or groups with a title for columns.
